title: EnsWilde Patch Definition Schema
description:
Defines loadable patches for EnsWilde. Supports data-driven MobileGestalt/Plist/File patches via JSON, and optional custom Swift modules for complex UI/apply logic (e.g. Wallet image picker).

Place simple patches in Patches/ (core) or Patches/Community/ (future user-contributed, loaded from Documents if enabled).
Contribute complex ones by adding JSON + optional Sources/PatchModules/YourPatch.swift conforming to PatchModule protocol.

targetPath.description: Plist path or destination for FileWrite

value.description: Flexible value: bool, string, number, dict, array

customModule.description: Optional: name of Swift type conforming to PatchModule for custom behavior

example.title: Example MobileGestalt Patch
example.description: Demonstrates setting a MobileGestalt key (replace with real key for your patch).
